column3: It's December 31st, 1999. Let's SAY GOODBYE to the OLD YEAR with a track you all know and love from GLOBAL sensation On-Lyne!
Not again!
Bastard.
I'm on break, Arthur. Don't mess with my gametime.
Need my Tommy keys, Amir. I'm not letting another lead on Entrati go to waste.
(Grunts) That, that was cheating.
My keys better not be in that mess.
Learn to hotwire, geez!
Did you take my damn keys?
Don't distract me, boyscout.
No disrespect, Quincy. Got places to be, is all.
Someone is taking my stuff.
How's she doing?
If she wasn't your blood, she'd be on her own out there.
Got a lead on Entrati. Sewers. Arse deep in Techrot, most likely. I'm going after him, for all our sakes. Lettie, look, if you've taken my keys again...
Hold up, hero boy. You're going after Doctor E all by yourself?
Or maybe you're gonna bail on us, Arthur? Forget it.
We're in this mess because of you.
I'm coming too! Guys? Uh... am I sensing some tension here?
No one's bailing. I got us into this, and if it kills me, I'll get us- fine. Aoi, Amir, Quincy on backup. Lettie, you and Eleanor hold the fort here, keep the gennies running.
The Doktor's dashing patient-zero in the flesh?
Shame. But my Scaldra have their orders.
Kill. On. Sight.
Pity. We could've been allies, kiddo. My Scaldra. Put that thing down!
Iced 'em. Too slow, Arthur.
I had it under control.
Have it your way. By this time next year, nothing will remain of you slugs.
Meet the co-star of your grand finale. An H-04 Efervon Tank. Enjoy.
Requesting assistance!
The vents above the treads!
Viktor? Drop them in. NOW.
Found a hole in its shield, Arthur!
Thanks, Quincy.
Wake up, brother. He comes. A crownless king, clad in gold. A pallid beast... tap-tap-tapping.
Arthur! What the hell was that? Where are you? Come in!
He's here. Deep in the Techrot. I'm going after him.
What in hell...
Entrati! What devils follow you?
Bring the hellfire!
That... was VERY rude.
Viktor. That's no way to treat our little tourist.
He won't talk.
Oh. Not even to me?
Hmph. Not my type.
Oh, but we're old friends.
Ha! That's it, isn't it? The poison to your plan.
Love.
Woah. Like Marty McFlea.
You takin' the piss?
If it's bullshit, I'll feed Marty here to the Techrot myself. But the clock's running out.
The nuke kinda makes sense, actually.
Happy New Year.
Well, you're on point, Marty. But you try any of those head games again and there won't be much left for Lettie to stitch back up. You read me?
Loud and clear.
Check me out. Givin' kit to Entrati's Cybercop.
Naw. More like V-1000. Sent to smoke us all, am I right?
Brrr! We got a blizzard coming in! Well, the On-lyne boys had better get their lip balm ready before the big show, or it's gonna be a chappy New Year!
So you just puppet this thing? Whole lot of metal in there...
Arthur's taking a chance on you. You hurt him, and I'll twist you inside out. Try not to scratch the paint.
Lettie, you buying this shit?
No, Aoi, I am not.
Cut the chatter. 19 hours til we're popping corks, or vaporized. We get Entrati and put a stop to this.

Höllvania. The eve of a new millennium brings with it great change. The war criminal Albrecht Entrati, father of the Techrot plague, has at last been captured. His co-conspirators, the terrorist cell known as 'Hex', will soon be brought to justice. Tonight, we will fill the great... Void of suffering. A New Year... A new era! Höllvania will be great once again!
Right, we're the terrorists. Love what you've done with the place, lady.
Lotta heat here in the opp-block, Arthur. You sure Marty's lead isn't just a setup? You holding something back, heroboy?
You wouldn't believe it anyway.
Amir, you said the nuke story made sense. This Y2K shit real?
Of course it's real. Some glitch in the old control software. Probably written in COBOL.
¡Ah chingao (Shit)!
Holding cells ahead. Big moment for you, Marty.
He'll be there.
You better have him. Marty? Is Entrati there?
He's gone. It's broken through already. Changing things.
Bollocks! Get your arse out of there! Quincy, Aoi, we need fire support!
I told you this was a set-up!
So what do you want me to do, Lettie?
Maybe, we cut our losses like we should've done weeks ago. We pack up and get the hell out of this estercolero before it's turned to ash. Just an idea!
You don't have a problem with a few hundred thousand going up in smoke?
Anyone still stuck here is Techrot anyway. Sometimes you have to amputate, Aoi. And cauterize.
Didn't come out here to cut an' hide. If Doctor E won't stop this, then I say we do it. Am I right, Amir? AMIR?
So where's Entrati? You said this was a loop.
Not anymore, is it? Your Boogeyman changed the rules. You're toast like the rest of us now.
Seems so. But that means we can change it too.
Stop the nuke.
No one listens.
Get me wired in.
The Techrot's pumping out spores.
I don't want more of that shit in my system!
Slow it, Lettie! Amir. Talk to me. Is your plan ready?
Uh... almost. Just needs a transponder onsite. Any Scaldra console down there should do it.
Hell-Scrubbers! Giant air filters to capture Techrot spores. I've commandeered their deployment system. Just need you to keep them pumping.
Quincy and Marty, keep the air clean while the rest of us search the tunnels for a terminal. You too, Lettie.
I start turning like Eleanor, I'll be haunting your ass.
New Hell-Scrubber inbound!
Likkle Amir knows all about these opps and their systems. A proper boss like you is smart enough to figure it out, innit, Marty?
Eleanor, you sensing any civilians down here?
Not one.
So. Wherever they're hiding out, it's above ground. That's a mercy.
Amir! Found a terminal!
Coming! What. No no no no no. That's... not a terminal, Arthur. Not any more.
Oh, shit. Aim for the head!
See this is why the Major wears a freakin' face mask.
Oh, please. You're as infected as the rest of us, Lettie.
Yeah? Look up 'latent infection', bitch.
Hold. Sensing a Scaldra force on the surface.
Even Scaldra got more sense than to come down here.
We'll see. Keep us posted.
Amir? You in?
Root access confirmed. Höllvania Public Utilities I am in you! Huh? MP3s?!-
What did you do, Amir? Come in? Comm's dead.
What is going on?
Isn't it great? Amir got these from the hack!
Amir! Can't hear myself think!
Sorry! Got it!
Awww... come on!
Kalymos?
She showed up after the hack. Uh. Look. Marty. Maybe we got off on the wrong-
Entrati.
...T-T-T-Tenno. If you are seeing this your loop has been altered.
No kidding.
You and I are trapped here. Soon the Murmur will crawl through the cracks and devour this world and its possibilities.
Our only means of escape... our only hope to contain this horror I have created... will require a spark of energy rare in this timeline. You know what this means.

Do not allow Arthur and the Hex to stop this. I realize what I am asking... but you of all people understand what is at stake. For the sake of everything before and to come... at midnight tonight... the 'bomb' must go off.
We found him, Marty! Come on!
Who?
We got chatter on Scaldra comms! They've been moving a V.I.P. at regular intervals. It's gotta be Dr. E, right? Meet me across town.
Fences up, Scaldra.
That convoy's a trap. I doubt Entrati's even on it.
If there's a chance he's on it, we have to try. Only he can stop this.
Convoy approaching the Mehra Tunnels. That's the place to hit them.
No air support. Smart.
I'm just a pretty face, Arthur. Oh sh-
Arthur, what if he doesn't know?
Just haul arse to Aoi. Rest of us will catch up.
Get these assholes off my back.
Too. Heavy.
Still not used to... whatever this is. Here. Let's ditch the cycles for something less... conspicuous.
Thaaaank yoooou!
Nice one, Marty!
Wasted!
Pick the bones out of that!
Yeah!!
Eat that, jerk!
Whammo!
That was a good one!
Hah hah hah hah ha.
Arthur's caught up!
So you're the new lapdog, kiddo? Tell me, Toto, what's he done to earn your loyalty?
You know this witch!?
Uh... it's complicated.
Not the jealous type! But! If I can't have him... you can't either!
Here is the breach. With each cycle, more seeps into her.
Who... who are you?
Kill her. Now.
You do it. I'm not your puppet.
But it's not really her that's doing this...
What? Then how would I be any different?
If you cannot sacrifice even this much... how will you do what comes next?
What's he talking about, Marty?
Maybe I won't.
Are you more a child than your other? Do you think I am not haunted by these choices?
Wahhh?!?? Marty's legit!
Nice score you got us here, Arthur. But you know what? I've had by fill of the circus. I'm out.
Quincy... c'mon man! Maybe we don't need Marty to stop this? Don't-
-North's your best bet. Mountains might be a chance against the fallout.
Cheers. Look-
-Anyone else? No?
We'll still follow you, brave king. But this half-assed plan's gone full-guano. Amir's Y2K thing won't even work.
Yeah. I should have said. Controller's air-gapped. Good policy actually.
Air-gapped.
Off net. We'd have to 'full-on' the reactor and patch it direct. Only about four thousand Scaldra to the six of us. Bad odds güey.
Five of us. Arthur, maybe it is time to bail.
There's an army beneath our feet. You all know it. My loving brother just needs to ask. I know he's itching to.
Eleanor... Arthur, don't you dare. She's barely hanging on as it is.
You said it yourself, Lettie. Bad odds. Eleanor. I'm asking. Please.
Please? A grand New Year's Eve, indeed. Okey-dokey, Arthur. Who's on point?
Princess Lucina Zoological Gardens. Free admission on New Year's Eve... if you can get past the Scaldra.
Scaldra think they've contained the outbreak here. But the Techrot here is different... more... patient... Biding their time...
They can do that?
Bad form to arrive early. And without your mystery date? I thought they taught Britannic men better...
Viktor, you love this city. Y2K is gonna haywire the plant. Call off your dogs for the night and help us.
Y2K? Ozone? Acid rain? And I took you for a warrior. Air support, you are go for drop.
Mediocre display. Not worth my time. Enjoy your picnic in the park, children.
Wait here. I do this alone.
I'm sorry we put you up to this.
We've waited. Our Severed. Sister.
I Queen of these. First sister from trees.
Sisters. Wicked. Always jealous to be queen.
Bad. Mad. Sad.
She won't come back from this.
Then none of us will.
Mine! Me! Mine!
Me. Help. You. Many friends!
Many friends. Yes.
Many.
Less one.
Are you more a child than your other? Do you think I am not haunted by these choices?
Entrati?! Get me out of here!
Shoot us in the back-
Eleanor is the first to die.
Eleanor!
Then Lettie.
Peak-a-boo.
See ya soon, momma.
I've seen enough, Albrecht!
Not that old dog. This is me.
Arthur! I can't-
(grunts)
These gifts you have: a piece of me. Given freely.
But those before you were butchers. Flayed flesh... for stolen stars.
I was... Too. Slow.
But those before you. They did not ask. They butchered me. My flesh fed their greed.
Just... go.

(Zeke) How are we doin' Holvaniaahhhhhhh?!?!! (DJ ROM) We can't heeeear you! (Zeke) Yo, sounds like someone's tryna kick off the party without us! (Harddrive) No way, man! Ain't no party 'til I show up! (Drillbit) Let's show 'em how it's really done! (Packet) Höllvania, you ever been in love? (Drillbit) And who's had their heart broken? We feel you. But trust me— stay strong. Time heals everything. And I know you know it, right? 'Cause love... is time.
Arthur, this place is swarming with Scaldra!
Hold there. She'll get it open.
Eleanor? You still okay?
We are fine.
What's going on down there. Eight-squad? Eight-squad report! Get Efervon units down there now!
Children! NO!!
Eleanor, hold here. I'll clear the gas.
Eleanor!
Shoot us in the back, Lettie?
Making sure that you are still... you.
Of course, we are.
And you can be, too.
Sir, the sub-floors have been breached. Requesting backup!
No! This is what they want. Hold!
What the hell? Wait... Quincy?!
You are proper shit at directions, Arthur. Heads down while I do my job, arright mate?
(pop?)
Got ya.
Peak-a-boo.
Show off. Better make a move, though. They'll get on you.
I'm seeing this through.
Go! I got this.
See ya soon, momma.
Don't have time for this!
Tell me you got this.
I can only type so fast!
Uh. Is that supposed to happen?
Amir?! Aoi, can you do something?
What do you want me to do?
I dunno, hold them in!
Aoi! Stop!
Arthur! I can't! I can't! Arthur! Ar-!
I was... Too. Slow.
He's ash in seconds. No need for misery. Come. Now.
Murmur expelled. Tau is in sight. They've given their lives for this. Make it count.
Just... go.
No. I can save them.
Not unless you know them.
(Grunts)
Eleanor is the first to die.
Shoot us in the back-
Eleanor? You still okay?
We are fine.
What's going on down there. Eight-squad? Eight-squad report! Get Efervon units down there now!
Children! NO!!
Eleanor, hold here. I'll clear the gas.
Eleanor!
Shoot us in the back, Lettie?
Making sure that you are still... you.
Of course, we are.
And you can be, too.
Eleanor, only here to help. It's up to you.
Eleanor... Eleanor!
I'm here.
And I thought we were becoming friends.
Sir, the sub-floors have been breached. Requesting backup!
No! This is what they want. Hold!
What the hell? Wait... Quincy?!
You are proper shit at directions, Arthur. Heads down while I do my job, arright mate?
Pop.
Got ya.
Peak-a-boo.
Show off. Better make a move, though. They'll get on you.
I'm seeing this through.
Go! I got this.
See?
Yeah. Yeah, I do.
Not today, momma. Area secure. Godspeed, Amir!
Did you forget? Albrecht's going to burn them all anyway!
Tell me you got this.
I can only type so fast!
Uh. Is that supposed to happen?
Amir?! Aoi, can you do something?
What do you want me to do?
I dunno, hold them in!
Aoi! Stop!
Arthur! I can't! I can't! Arthur! Ar-!
You can. You're strong enough.
Oh. Oh!
None of this matters.
Then why are you trying so hard to stop me?
We're not gonna make it man. I can't even compile in time-
-Then we go down swinging!
Not now. Not now.
Amir, slow it down.
I don't... have... time.
(Deep breath)
(Deep breath)
Hold out your hand.
Just... go. Mmm... dnnne.
Entrati...
Bailed.
Sorry... mbout yur hnnd.
Wha- are you-? Wait. nooo.
Hey, let's get out of here, Arthur. Both of us. Okay?
Okay.
Your heart would struggle to move them. It had to grow...
...the only way it ever does...
...with others. Carry this power with mercy, Tenno.
What a day.
Well that burned a few calories!
Man ain't nothin' without his mains. Respec'.
Right here by your side. Now and always.
I'm not afraid to die... but I'm glad I didn't.
Hey! After this we go for dinner.
